conditions: Normal requestAnimationFrame and the production FixedClock. A controller supplies only gameplay inputs before each ordinary physics step. No time acceleration. 6-second warm-up excludes first-use shader compilation; sequential cases, no parallel benchmark browser. Browser cache is explicitly cleared then compared with a reload. Local HTTP server filesystem cache is not cleared. Touch profiles use the same desktop Apple M2 GPU and do not measure phone hardware.
targets: Desktop aims for 60 FPS; 55 FPS mean is the report acceptance band. Emulated touch aims for >=30 FPS; 28 FPS mean is the acceptance band. Reported P95/P99 expose stalls independently of the mean.
